subject: riotInterceptor
pitch:
Category: Vehicle.
Subject: corporate riot-control interceptor with a water cannon and neon light bars.
Style: Cyberpunk 2077.
reasoning:
I'm planning a single TS module for a static armored wheeled interceptor model, sketching dimensions around 5.4m length, 2.3m width, 2.2m height with four large wheels, keeping the structure compact since static models don't need joints.

I'm working out the body details: a lower hull box, angled cabin wedge, roof light bars, a roof-mounted water cannon turret, bull bar, glowing headlights, side stripes, tinted windows, antennas, and undercarriage neon accents, all built from box and cylinder helper functions with proper axis orientation for wheels. Now I'm defining the hull's side profile as an extruded shape, plotting points along the vehicle's length and height to form the sloped hood, windshield, and roof curve.

Still writing extrusion profiles...

Now I'm laying out the rooftop details: a water cannon turret with angled barrel and nozzle, a split red/blue light bar glowing up front, magenta and cyan neon underglow strips, plus headlights, taillights, and a horizontal water tank cylinder on the rear bed.

I need to resolve a placement conflict between the cabin and tank, so I'm shortening the cabin so it ends further forward, then positioning the tank behind it on the hull with neon cyan ring bands and a corp emblem detail.

Now I'm placing a water cannon turret on the cabin roof with a forward-pointing barrel, adjusting its height so it clears a light bar mounted below it, then setting up the wheel positions symmetrically at the hull's width.

For the wheels, I'm detailing glowing cyan rims with gray hubs and black tires, and defining a color palette of navy armor, dark accents, white stripes, yellow and cyan highlights, plus magenta, red, and blue for faction markings. I'm also considering adding a corporation-style decal to the side using a texture plane.

For the decal, I'm placing two text planes on opposite hull sides, facing outward so the "RIOT·SEC" label reads correctly from either direction, sized to fit within the hull's extruded profile.

Now I'm adding details: hazard stripes on the bull bar, a front bumper box with glowing magenta grille slits, plus antenna, mirrors, side skirts, license plate, and exhaust accents, aiming to keep the whole script around 200 lines.

Writing box helper code...

Setting cabin thickness to 1.9 with extruded side profiles, orienting wheels along the x-axis, and defining a cylinder helper function for radius, length, color, position, direction, and side count.
